Select approved drugs with max_phase = 4 and action_type containing 'MODULATOR'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno. Join target_dictionary on drug_mechanism.tid. Join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), and target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name). Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
